tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtad hrul zangs gling pa'i zur 'debs bka' rgya can dge/ mnan gtad kyi sbyor ba bshig pa'i man ngag bzhugs so/ /dpal 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma 'ongs dus kyi snyigs ma la/ /drag sngags sbyor ba rbod gtong gis skam gtad rlon gtad gang yang rung / bshig pa'i 'khor lo 'di bya'o/ /gdams pa ni 'thebs ldog rtsis la/ theb pa'i dus su skam la bcug pas/ mnan gtad skam la bcug pa thams cad dam tshig gcig pas/ skam gtad kyi nus pa bshig go /rlon la bcug pas/ klu dang bdud mo sogs gang du gnas par bcug pas mnan gtad dang dam tshig gcig pas/ rlon gtad kyi nus pa thams cad bshig go /'di bzlog pa'i mchog ste/ pha rol gshed 'bebs su'ang 'gro'o/ /lan gsum dang lnga la sogs pa skyar kyang rung ngo / /'dis rgyus med du mnan pa byas pa thams cad 'dis bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /gdams pa 'dis bca' gzhi la/ gro shog klu sman gyis bskul ba la/ 'khor lo gnyis byas te/ pho 'khor ni rus sbal lto bar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ de'i phyi ma mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar/ phu phu/ spu ta spu ta/ che ge mo la rbod gtong dang mnan 'dre yod pa bzlog rtsibs brgyad kyi rtsibs re re la/ phu phu gnyis gnyis bri'o/ /rtsibs chen la/ pha rol gnod byed kyi rbod gtong / spu ta spu ta/ mnan 'dre ma hā kro ta ya hūm̐/ si ti si ti ta ya hūm̐/ mu khyud la/ phu ma ni pa ni a lo gan te he sa ni sa kho'i ga khe na ga le/ na ga le/ a ge a ge nā ga ra tsa/ nā ga ra tsa/ tsi tsi/ dzi tsi/ 'du she 'du she/ du pa ya/ du pa ya/ nā ga ra tsa che ge mo la rbod gtong dang mnan 'dre yod pa bzlog bzlog ces bri/ mo 'khor ni/ rus sbal lto bar pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar/ che ge mo la rbod gtong dang mnan 'dre bzlog pad+ma la phu phu si ti si ti/ phu phu phaṭa/ phu phu bzlog bzlog phu phu si ti si ti/

phu phu spo ta spo ta/ phu phu hūm̐/ phu phu spo ta ya/ phu phu bhid ti/ mu khyud kyi sngags pho dang mtshungs pa la/ pho rnams la/ mo bzlog par 'bri'o/ /rus sbal gnyis gan rkyal skyed tshe dod par bri'o/ /sngags byang bu can lhag chad med par gces so/ /sngags rnams klu sman dri bzang pos byugs 'di 'jug pa'i dus su klu la gtor ma btang / ma nyes pa'i dpang gzug bden pa bdar zhing gser skyems kyis mchod/ bdag la gzhan gyis mnan gtad phung shig gi sbyor ba ngan pa byas pa thams cad bshig cig de dag gi sbyor ba'i 'bras bu med par gyis shig klu gnyan yul bdag dregs pa can khyed rnams dang / bdag gnyis 'khon med cing bsdum par byas pa yin no/ /gshed dang bdud du ma mdzad par lha dang dpal mdzod la zhi ba dang bde legs su mdzod cig ces dmod bcol gang shes bya'o/ /'khor lo gnyis zhal sbyor du sdebs la 'bru sman dar zab rat+na dang bcas glang rur bcug chu'i mi 'jig pa'i bca' ga kha la chas bsdams rting rdo dang bcas chur bsgyur ro/ /skam pa la yang glang rus bcug pa skam la rbad/ de ltar byas pas sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad kyi nus pa 'jig pa dang rul ba dang med par 'gyur ro/ /sngags pa nang rgyas byung ba'i tshe/ /mkhas pa zangs gling dbang phyug gis/ /ḍā ki ma yi bka' dang bstun/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams bzlog pa'i phyir/ /bshig 'khor zhes su grags pa ste/ /bcas chog man ngag yin pa'i phyir/ /bsgom dang bzlas pa 'dir ma dgos/ /'di nyid pir gyi kha bzhin du/ /gzhan du ma spel kha tham rgya/ /ru ṭa rnams kyi 'di mthong na/ /mthu la mi 'jigs dpa' bor 'gyur/ /de phyir bstan dgra rnams la sba/ /sa ma ya/ ྀatsha/ gtad hrul gyi zhal shes ni/ dang por 'khor lo legs par bris la pho 'khor steng dang mo 'khor 'og tu byas la mgo nas sgril/ btab rtsis gang byung phya pe byas pa de/ zheng ches na lte ba ma chag par g.yas g.yon gnyis nas bkug

tshon skud sngo dmar gyi rim pa gsum dkris la bcad/ de nas yang rgyab tu gsum dkris la bcad/ de yugs sa ma'i zhabs ma'am ras nag gis dril/ tshon skud gong ltar dkris la chas mi mngon par gtum/ skyes pa du yod kyi brla g.yon gyi sgyid pa la phyi skor lan gsum drangs/ bud med du yod kyi sgyid pa g.yas la lan gsum skor/ de khyi'i rkang pa g.yon la phyi skor lan gsum/ rang 'thag gi ya 'go zur slang nas/ bug pa la phyi skor theng gsum/ de glang rur bcug la/ g.yam pa'am 'dam gyi kha bcad/ de steng la chas bcad/ de rwa bas phur/ gres thag gi bcings rang la rnam rtog yod pa'i mtsho la ci mang bskyur/ skam la yang khyi mgo gas chag med pa'am/ glang ru gang rung du gong bzhin bcug la/ la rdzas lha tshugs mgon khang gi 'gram sogs dogs pa za bar mnan/ 'khor lo'i spel tshig la rang dang sbyin bdag gi ming 'bri dgos na de mthar gla rtsi'i byugs/ ma bris na mi byugs bskyur dus rlung g.yas nas rgyu ba byung na bzang / ma byung na sna g.yon bkag nas g.yas la bsgyur bar bya/ 'khor lo 'dri ba dang bsgyur ba gnyis la gnam stong la bya/ sgra gcan rtsi tshul gtor bzlog bzhin/ gong du dpang gzugs brjod par gsungs pa ni 'di skad bya ste/ skyabs gnas dam pa rnams dang khyad par sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i lha klu bdud btsan ma mo la sogs pa dregs byed ci mchis thams cad thugs ma yengs par dgongs shing / bdag dang sbyin bdag rnams nas gnas skabs kun tu mchod 'os gtsug tu khur/ bskyang 'os spun zla ltar bskyangs/ byams 'os 'gro ba kun la brtse sems rgyun mi chad par bsgom pa yin kyang / rbod gtong brgyad la 'khor bcas kyi gnod cing lan chags nas 'dug tu mi ster ba 'dug go /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas nas byad ma rnams la lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas phog 'gal du 'gro ba spu tsam byas min dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang /

'dir 'dus dregs byed 'khor bcas kyi zag bcas zag med mngon shes kyis dgongs shig gzigs shig byad ma rnams nas lus kyi rdzas gsog lugs sam/ ngag gi sngags bzlas lugs sam/ sems kyi dmigs pa zhe ngan ci byas thams cad khyed rnams kyi mi mkhyen cing mi gzigs pa skad cig kyang med pas/ bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas bden pa bden thog tu thon la/ mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod cig gdug can byad ma rbad 'dre bcas pa 'phral du tshar gcod rjes bzung ma mdzad na rang gzhan kun 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las thar dus med pa ma zad/ lha 'dre dregs pa can khyed rnams kyang nyes med sems can gyi srog dbugs la rngams pa las/ gdug can 'di dag myur du zos na za ba'i za go dang / btung ba'i btung go chod par 'dug pas byad ma 'khor bcas kyi lus srog longs spyod thams cad khyed rnams kyi zhal du btab bo/ /gang bcol phrin las thams cad myur du sgrubs shig rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha lha srin sde brgyad/ yul lha gzhi bdag bdag dang sbyin bdag la 'go ba'i lha lnga 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang / rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i༞ rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi༞ bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi steng na nyes pa med pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ byad ma gdug can rnams nas rdzas sngags ting 'dzin rbad 'dre rbod gtong ngan g.yo 'khrul gsum ci dang ci bgyis pa thams cad lo zla zhag dang za ma ma 'gyangs par byad ma lha srung 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi steng du bzlog cig ces brjod la thal mo lan gsum brdab/ gser skyems bshams la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ gser skyems kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por 'di nyid 'bul zhing mchod pa'i yul du gyur pa ni/

rtsa brgyud zhes pa nas/ lha lnga zhes pa'i bar gong dang 'dra ba la/ 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /mgron no/ /zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dis tshim zhing mnyes nas bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod la yid la brnag pa'i byad ma rbad 'dre 'khor bcas thal ba'i rdul du brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod la gser skyems gtor/ bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la gzhan gyi mnan gtad phung shig sbyor ba ngan pa bshig cig de dag gis bsam sbyor gyi 'bras bu med par gyis shig klu gnyan dregs pa can khyed rnams dang bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas 'khon med cing bsdum par byas pa yin no/ /gshed dang bdud du ma mdzad par lha dang dpal du mdzod la/ zhi ba dang bde legs su mdzod cig zhes brjod nas/ rwa rtse phar bstan la mtshor skyur ba'am sa khung du bcug phu ma ni si ni a lo ga na te ho se ni sa kha'i na ga le na ga le a ge a ga na ga ra tsa na ga ra tsa/ tsi tsi dzi tsi/ 'du she 'du she 'du pa ya 'du pa ya na ga ra tsa/ pha rol gyi rbod gtong mnan gtad bzlog bzlog ces brjod la sa khung mi mngon par bya'o/ /zhes mkhas pa zangs gling dbang phyug gi gter gzhung nyid gong du smos shing 'gro ba'i phyag len gyi mthar dpang gzugs man sa skya pa kun blos gsar brtsom bgyis pa dge/ //yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ gtad hrul zangs gling pa'i zur 'debs bka' rgya can/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
